DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 犬を連れて散歩されるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are taking your dog for a walk, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。あの芝生で一緒に休みたいのですが、犬も入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬連れで利用したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to rest together on that lawn. Are dogs allowed there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to use the park with your dog. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その芝生の区画は、犬の立ち入りをご遠慮いただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Dogs are not permitted in that section of the lawn.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人が入れる芝生でも、犬は入れない区画なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 芝生の立入条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So people may enter that lawn, but dogs may not enter that section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for entering the lawn. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。犬連れの散歩は、外側の園路でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please walk with your dog on the outer park paths.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、芝生を横切らずに外の道を歩きます。リードを付けたままで使う道ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 犬が入れない区画を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will use the outer path without crossing the lawn. That is a path where I keep the leash on, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm which section dogs may not enter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。通行する方と距離を取れる長さでお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Hold the leash at a length that keeps distance from people passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: リードを短く持ち、道の端を歩きます。休むなら園路沿いの広い所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用できる園路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hold it short and walk along the edge. If we rest, I will look for a wide spot beside the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a park path you may use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広い所でも、他の方の通り道は空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even in a wide spot, keep other people's passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。芝生へは入れず、外側の園路で犬と歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: リードと歩く位置を確認して出発する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep the dog off the lawn and walk on the outer paths.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the leash and walking position before setting off. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。外側の道はこちらです。犬の様子を見ながらお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. The outer path is this way. Please watch your dog's condition as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらへ向かわれますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 終点の先の観光駅へ行きたいです。この方面の列車なら、どれでも乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的駅を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the sightseeing station beyond the terminus. Can I take any train in this direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your destination station. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初に出る列車は途中の中央駅止まりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The first departing train terminates partway at Central Station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 観光駅までは行かないんですね。中央駅でまた乗り換える必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近い発車の列車で行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it does not go as far as the sightseeing station. Would I need to transfer again at Central Station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the next departing train will get you there. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場合は乗り換えです。次の列車なら観光駅へ直接行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, you must transfer. The following train goes directly to the sightseeing station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、乗り換えを増やさず、次の直通列車を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中止まりの駅を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will wait for the next direct train instead of adding a transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the station where the train terminates partway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行先表示に観光駅の名前が出ますので、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The destination display will show the sightseeing station's name. Please check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 発車の順番だけで選ばず、観光駅の名前がある列車にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次の直通列車を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not choose solely by departure order. I will take a train displaying the sightseeing station's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the next direct train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。最初の中央駅止まりが出た後も、同じホームでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After the first train terminating at Central Station leaves, keep waiting on this platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このホームで待ち、行先を確かめて次に乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行先表示を見て乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait on this platform, check the destination and take the following train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the destination display before boarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。直通列車の発車案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is the departure information for the direct train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記載項目で迷っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure which details to include?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。勤務先に出す証明書です。本籍も載せた方が詳しくてよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 必要な証明書と提出先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is a certificate for my employer. I thought including my registered domicile would make it more detailed and better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the certificate you need and whom you will submit it to. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have instructions from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。「本籍省略」と書いてあります。これは載せない指定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内の記載項目を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. It says to omit the registered domicile. Does that mean I should not include it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the listed details in the instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その文言は、本籍の記載を省く指定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording specifies that the registered domicile should be left out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 詳しくすればよいわけではないんですね。その指定に合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本籍省略の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So more detail is not necessarily better. I would like to follow that specification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what omitting the registered domicile means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 他の項目も案内と見比べてご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare the other details with the instructions as you fill it out too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。氏名と住所は必要、本籍は省略と、案内どおり選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定に合う項目を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will select name and address as required and omit registered domicile, as instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose details matching the specification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入後に、申請内容を窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After you fill it out, we will check the application at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 選択した項目をもう一度確認してから提出します。案内も一緒に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申請内容を提出前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check my selections once more before submitting it. I will show the instructions as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the application before submission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。提出先の指定と申請内容を照合して受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will compare the application with the recipient's requirements and accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬は、袋の指示どおりに使われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you use the medicine according to the instructions on the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋には食後とありますが、今朝は食べずに飲んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬袋の指示を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bag says after meals, but this morning I took it without eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the instructions on the medicine bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に飲んだ時のことを、詳しくお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please explain in detail what happened when you actually took it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝七時に飲み、朝食は九時でした。袋の食後の指示とは違っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の服用状況が違ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took it at seven in the morning and ate breakfast at nine. That differs from the after-meal instructions on the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your actual use differed from the instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時刻と順番を記録して、診察の担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will record the times and sequence and tell the staff responsible for your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。次はどう飲めばいいか、担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食事と服用の順を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to ask them how I should take the next dose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the sequence of eating and taking the medicine. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。袋も診察で見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please show the bag during the consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋の指示は食後、実際は七時の服用が先で九時に食事、と分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次の服用を自己判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will explain separately that the bag says after meals, but I actually took it first at seven and ate at nine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not decide on the next dose yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の使用についても、担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with the responsible staff about the next use too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で追加して調整せず、次の服用について質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者へ確認する内容をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not take extra to adjust it myself. I will ask about the next dose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize what you need to check with the responsible staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。実際の使用状況と、ご質問をあわせて担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will pass on both your actual use and your questions to the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受けた電話について、どのような内容でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What were the calls you received about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない田中さんを探す電話が三回来ました。相手は、この番号が連絡先として登録されていると言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない人を探す電話が繰り返し来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received three calls looking for a Tanaka whom I do not know. The caller says this number is registered as the contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you repeatedly received calls looking for someone you do not know. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 田中さんとお知り合いですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。私はこの番号を最近使い始めました。前に誰が使っていたかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 探されている人を知らず以前の番号利用者も不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I only recently started using this number. I do not know who used it before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the person being sought or the number's former user. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手から支払いや、何かの手続きを求められましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did the caller demand payment or any procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 田中さんの代わりに住所を教えてと言われましたが、知らないので何も伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別人の住所を求められたが情報を伝えていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They asked me to give an address on Tanaka's behalf, but I do not know it, so I gave no information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you were asked for someone else's address but gave no information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話を受けた記録と、相手が説明した内容を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take the call records separately from what the caller claimed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着信の時刻は残っています。でも、本当にその会社の登録にこの番号があるかは確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着信履歴と相手が主張する未確認の登録情報を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the incoming call times. But I have not confirmed whether this number is really registered with that company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your call history from the caller's unverified registration claim. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その未確認の点も記録します。相手への対応については担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record that unverified point too. Please consult the responsible staff about responding to the caller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が田中さんだと認めたわけではありません。着信履歴と会話のメモで、今後の対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人だと認めておらず履歴とメモで今後の対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not acknowledged that I am Tanaka. I would like advice about future responses using the call history and conversation notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have not admitted being that person and want advice using your history and notes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。別人を探す連絡を受けた事実として、記録を確認しながら担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the records and connect you with the responsible staff, treating this as calls received looking for someone else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのラベルで発送しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will send it with this label, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。住所は合っていますが、受取人の名前が前の同居人になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ラベルの宛名の誤りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. The address is correct, but the recipient's name is my former housemate's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the error in the addressee's name on the label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正しい受取人のお名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the correct recipient's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この箱は友人の佐藤さん宛てです。住所を写す時、古い氏名を残してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所は正しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. This box is for my friend Sato. When copying the address, I left the old name in place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the address is correct. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送前ですので、ラベルを正しい内容で作り直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It has not been shipped yet, so please make a new label with the correct details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。住所も名前も一緒に全部間違ったわけではないので、正しい住所は残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人本人の名前を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. The address and name are not both wrong, so I will keep the correct address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the actual recipient's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直した後、両方をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After rewriting it, please check both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の連絡を見て、住所は今の新居、氏名は佐藤さんと照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送前のラベル修正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check my friend's message and verify the current new home's address and Sato as the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the label before shipping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ラベルができましたら、こちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the label is ready, please bring it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書き直しました。新居の住所も佐藤さんのお名前も合っています。このラベルで出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と氏名を別々に照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have rewritten it. Both the new home's address and Sato's name are correct. I will send it with this label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the address and name separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。修正後のラベルを確認して、発送を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will check the corrected label and accept the shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 支店の選択でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble selecting the branch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。名前の似た支店が二つ出ます。最初の候補でよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た支店名で迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two branches with similar names appear. I am unsure whether the first option is right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are confused by similar branch names. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 請求書の支店名と、支店コードをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the branch's name and branch code on the invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。コードは、口座番号の上の三桁の数字でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求書の正式名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the name. Is the code the three-digit number above the account number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the official name on the invoice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 「支店コード」と書かれた欄ですね。候補の情報にも表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is the field marked branch code. It is also displayed in the options' information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この三桁と一致するのは二つ目でした。名前が似ていても、最初を選ぶところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支店コードの位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The second option matches these three digits. I nearly picked the first just because the names are similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where the branch code is. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一致する情報を確認して進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check that the information matches before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つ目を選びます。その後も口座番号と名義を請求書に合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コードを照合して候補を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will choose the second. After that I will also match the account number and account holder's name to the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the codes and choose an option. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確定の前に振込先全体と金額をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Before confirming, check all the recipient's details and the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支店コード、口座番号、名義、金額をそろえて見ます。確認できてから確定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他の振込情報も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will review the branch code, account number, account holder's name and amount together. I will finalize only after checking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the other transfer information too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順でお願いします。ご不明な表示があれば、確定前にお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that procedure. If a display is unclear, ask us before finalizing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払いの処理中です。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your payment is processing. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面が変わったので終わったと思い、袋に入れ始めました。まだ通信中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 端末の状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen changed, so I thought it was finished and began bagging. Is it still communicating?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the terminal's status. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。完了表示はまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. The completion message has not appeared yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、残りの品物はここに置いて待ちます。もう一度操作する必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ完了していないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will leave the remaining items here and wait. Do I need to operate it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is not complete yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は追加の操作をせずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait without any further operation now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。同じ支払いを重ねず、この処理の結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 品物を移すのを待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not duplicate the same payment and will wait for this transaction's result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait before moving the items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 完了しました。こちらがレシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is complete. Here is your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 完了画面とレシートを確認しました。これで袋に移してよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完了画面とレシートを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the completion screen and receipt. I can move the items into bags now, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the completion screen and receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。品物を詰め台へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please take the items to the packing counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。全部そろえて、詰め台で袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い済みの商品を袋に入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will gather everything and bag it at the packing counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put the paid items in bags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計は完了しています。レシートも忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your payment is complete. Please remember to take your receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお探しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着です。散歩の途中で脱ぎ、ベンチに置いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上着を置いた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My jacket. I took it off during my walk and may have left it on a bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you may have left your jacket there. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのベンチか、目印は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember which bench or any landmarks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池のそばで、横に赤い花の花壇がありました。その後、東の広場へ歩きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチの特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was by the pond, with a flower bed of red flowers beside it. After that, I walked to the eastern square.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the bench's surroundings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら池の北側のベンチかもしれません。こちらの地図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then it may be the bench north of the pond. Let's check on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この位置です。池から花壇、東の広場の順に歩きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通った順を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is this spot. I walked from the pond to the flower bed and then the eastern square.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the order of places you passed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理所へ届いていないか確認できます。上着の色は何色ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check whether it has been handed in at the management office. What color is the jacket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 灰色で、袖に青い線があります。その特徴で聞いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得物の有無を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gray, with blue stripes on the sleeves. Could you ask using those features?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check whether your lost item has been found. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。届いていなければ、元のベンチもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check. If it has not been handed in, please also check the original bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。先に届けられた物を確認し、なければ地図のベンチへ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元のベンチにも案内に従って戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will first check what has been handed in, then return to the bench on the map if it is not there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Follow the directions and return to the original bench too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。管理所へ、灰色で袖に青い線のある上着として問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask the management office about a gray jacket with blue stripes on the sleeves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の列車が遅れているのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your reserved train is delayed, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先に別の列車が来るようなので、それに乗れば早く行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約列車の遅れを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Another train seems to be arriving first. Would I get there sooner by taking that one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the delay to your reserved train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの券によって利用条件が違います。拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Conditions depend on the ticket you have. May I see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。予約列車の名前と席が書いてあります。このまま別の列車の同じ席に座れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別列車への変更希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It shows the reserved train's name and seat. Can I use it as it is and sit in the same seat on the other train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you would like to change to another train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ席番号でも、その列車のお席とは限りません。変更できるか担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even with the same seat number, it is not necessarily your seat on that train. The responsible staff will check whether a change is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。早く来たからといって、自分の券でそのまま乗れるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持っている券を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. So just arriving earlier does not mean I can take it with my ticket as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present your ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。空席と変更の扱いを確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. We will check availability and how changes are handled before advising you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の予約を勝手に取り消さず、別の列車を使えるか聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用条件の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to decide after asking whether I can use another train, without cancelling my current reservation on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the conditions of use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。両方の運行状況と券の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will check both trains' operating status and the ticket conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別の列車にはまだ乗らず、案内を待ちます。利用できる場合の席や追加費用も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に別列車へ乗らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not board the other train yet and will wait for guidance. If I can use it, I also want to ask about the seat and additional costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not board another train before checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。変更の可否、席、費用をそろえてご説明しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will explain whether you can change, the seat and costs together. Please wait here.
